summary: Biohaven Ltd. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement to amend an existing equity distribution agreement, allowing it to offer up to $350 million in common shares via an at-the-market offering through J.P. Morgan as sales agent. The filing updates a prior $300 million program, under which $181.3 million had been sold, leaving $118.7 million. The agent receives up to 3% compensation. This is routine capital-raising, not a special situation.
